title: 第7章 黑市巡逻你们管这叫巡逻第8章 我爹是柳二江啪
content_zh:
晚上八点，负一楼停车场。
陈邪换了一身行头，黑色休闲裤，纯白t恤，外面套着一件夹克。
人靠衣装马靠鞍，这话不假。
他本来就长得不赖，这么一收拾，再配上那股子邪性，往那一站，就是个少妇杀手。
大白鹅跟在他脚边，迈着六亲不认的步伐，东瞅瞅西看看，对停车场里那些铁皮疙瘩很不屑。
“就坐这玩意儿去？还没鹅爷我飞得快。”
萧逸已经站在一辆黑色的越野车旁，听到这话，面皮一抽。
他拉开车门：“上车吧，陈邪。”
陈邪一屁股坐进副驾，大白鹅扑腾一下，占了整个后排。
萧逸发动车子，越野车驶出停车场。
“陈邪，今晚的任务，是去黑市巡逻。”萧逸边开车边介绍。
“啥玩意儿？”
陈邪掏了掏耳朵，怀疑自己听错了。
“黑市？巡逻？”
这俩词是怎么凑到一块儿的？
黑市之所以叫黑市，不就是因为它见不得光，专门躲着你们这种官方机构吗？
你们现在倒好，直接跑去人家地盘上巡逻？
这不是上门挑事儿吗？
“嘎！还是你们749会玩。”后排的大白鹅也叫了一声。
萧逸对这反应不意外，苦笑着解释：“我们七处，主要负责的就是西开市城区内的一切特殊事件。”

“听起来挺高大上，其实就是个闲职。”
“这活儿，钱多事少离家近，平时基本没危险，顶多就是像今晚这样，去黑市溜达一圈，或者处理一些不开眼的小妖小鬼。”
陈邪听明白了。
感情这行动部七处，就是个养老部门。
怪不得办公室里那几位一个个都奇形怪状的，敢情都是来摸鱼的。
他感觉自己上当了。
就这？
就这？
我一身惊天动地的本事，你让我去巡逻？
陈邪咂了咂嘴，一脸不爽。
车子一路向西，最后停在了一条古玩街的街口。
晚上九点，整条街黑灯瞎火，所有店铺都关着门，连个鬼影子都没有，安静得诡异。
“就是这儿了。”萧逸熄了火。
“这地方，布置了空间阵法，普通人就算从街口走过去，也什么都发现不了。”
萧逸带着一人一鹅下了车，径直走向街口。
陈邪能感觉到空气中有一层微弱的灵力波动，形成了一道无形的屏障，将整条街笼罩。
萧逸从口袋里掏出一块黑色的玉牌，在空气中晃了晃。
眼前的空间扭曲了一下。
“走吧。”
一步踏入。

眼前的景象瞬间天翻地覆。
原本冷清死寂的街道，此刻人影绰绰，摩肩接踵，热闹非凡。
街道两旁，不再是古玩店，而是一个个简陋的摊位。
摊位上摆放着各种稀奇古怪的东西，带血的骨头、闪着幽光的矿石、瓶瓶罐罐里装着不知名的液体，甚至还有活物在笼子里挣扎。
空气中混杂着血腥、药草和各种妖物的古怪气味。
content_en:
Eight o'clock in the evening, parking lot on the first floor.
Chen Xie changed his outfit, wearing black casual pants, a pure white T-shirt, and a jacket.
It is true that a man relies on his clothes and a horse relies on his saddle.
He was not bad looking to begin with, but with this combination and his evil nature, he turned out to be a killer of young women.
The big white goose followed at his feet, taking steps that he didn't recognize, looking here and there, disdainful of the iron-skinned bumps in the parking lot.
"Are you going to sit on this thing? I can fly faster than Mr. Goose."
Xiao Yi was already standing next to a black off-road vehicle. When he heard this, his face twitched.
He opened the car door: "Get in the car, Chen Xie."
Chen Xie plopped into the passenger seat, and the big white goose flapped and occupied the entire back seat.
Xiao Yi started the car and the off-road vehicle drove out of the parking lot.
"Chen Xie, tonight's mission is to patrol the black market." Xiao Yi introduced while driving.
"What the hell?"
Chen Xie picked his ears and suspected that he heard wrongly.
"Black market? Patrol?"
How did these two words come together?
Isn't the reason why the black market is called a black market because it is shady and hides from official institutions like you?
How about you go and patrol other people's territory now?
Isn’t this just coming to pick up trouble?
"Gah! You still know how to play 749." The big white goose in the back row also called.
Xiao Yi was not surprised by this reaction and explained with a wry smile: "Our Seventh Division is mainly responsible for all special events in Xikai City."
"It sounds very high-level, but it's actually just a sinecure."
"It's a job that pays a lot of money but doesn't have much to do. It's close to home. It's basically not dangerous at ordinary times. At most, like tonight, I just go to the black market for a walk or deal with some blind little monsters."
Chen Xie understood.
Department 7 of the Emotional Action Department is a senior care department.
No wonder those people in the office are all weird-looking and they are all here to fish.
He felt he had been cheated.
That's it?
That's it?
I have earth-shattering abilities, and you want me to go on patrol?
Chen Xie smacked his lips, looking unhappy.
The car headed west and finally stopped at the intersection of an antique street.
At nine o'clock in the evening, the whole street was dark, all the shops were closed, there was not even a ghost, and it was eerily quiet.
"This is it." Xiao Yi put out the fire.
"This place has a space formation. Ordinary people can't find anything even if they walk past the street."
Xiao Yi got out of the car with one person and one goose, and walked straight to the street.
Chen Xie could feel a layer of weak spiritual power fluctuations in the air, forming an invisible barrier that enveloped the entire street.
Xiao Yi took out a black jade plaque from his pocket and shook it in the air.
The space in front of him was distorted.
"Let's go."
Step in.
The scene in front of him was turned upside down in an instant.
The originally deserted and dead streets were now filled with people, crowded and bustling.
On both sides of the street, there are no longer antique shops, but simple stalls.
There were all kinds of strange things on the stalls, including bloody bones, glowing ores, bottles and jars filled with unknown liquids, and even living creatures struggling in cages.
The air was mixed with the weird smell of blood, herbs and various monsters.
